title: D04: Define BNGIR version defaults, compatibility and semantic equality

source.contract: Make BNGIR v0.2 the default lossless wire version representing all BNGL constructs including physical units, observable kinds, and delayed rules without data loss; implement exact process semantic equality distinguishing process equivalence from numerical similarity.

oracle.identity: Independent exact network enumerator, proof certificates, and semantic-equal-design.md EQ-* test suite.
oracle.law: Semantic equality holds if and only if process transition structures match up to consistent renaming, observable definitions, and conserved transition rate sums; numerical similarity never establishes equality; unprovable procedures raise explicit EqualityUndecided.
